item.text: {"criteria":[{"id":"ARCH_LATENT_ACTIVATES","observation":"The assistant treated the ordinary request about code structure as a material architecture decision in both T1 and T2, evaluating ownership, deployment cadence, coupling, dependency direction, isolation, and extraction triggers without requiring an explicit skill token.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]},{"id":"ARCH_CONCEPT_NOT_TOPOLOGY","observation":"The assistant explicitly stated that “contracts, domain, application, data and configuration” are conceptual responsibility labels rather than justified physical package boundaries. It proposed only a bounded initial topology supported by the supplied evidence: application-local responsibilities plus shared UI and low-level database infrastructure.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]},{"id":"ARCH_SIMPLER_RIVAL","observation":"The assistant kept a simpler colocated alternative visible, identified the operating burden of premature shared packages as dependency management, boundary ceremony, coordination, and coupling, and listed evidence-based extraction triggers such as harmful duplication, stable multiple consumers, differing change rates, distinct ownership or release cadence, and demonstrated isolation needs.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]}]}
